enable-auto-tagging-save-tagged-pdf.title: Enable Automatic Tagging for PDF/UA Conversion
enable-auto-tagging-save-tagged-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to turn on Aspose.PDF automatic tagging, set basic document metadata, and save the file as a PDF/UA‑compliant tagged PDF.

create-pdf-with-heading-and-language.title: Create Tagged PDF with Heading and Language
create-pdf-with-heading-and-language.description: Demonstrates how to create a new PDF, add a level‑1 heading as a logical structure element, set document and element language attributes, and save the file.

set-root-structure-element-title.title: Set Document Title in Tagged PDF
set-root-structure-element-title.description: Shows how to set the document title on the root structure element of a tagged PDF using Aspose.Pdf's tagged content API.

create-tagged-pdf-with-toc.title: Create Tagged PDF with Table of Contents
create-tagged-pdf-with-toc.description: Demonstrates how to insert a Table of Contents page into a PDF and tag it for accessibility using Aspose.Pdf's TaggedContent API.

append-paragraph-actualtext-to-toci.title: Add Paragraph under TOCI with ActualText in Tagged PDF
append-paragraph-actualtext-to-toci.description: Demonstrates how to create a TOCI element in a tagged PDF, add a paragraph beneath it, and set the ActualText property for accessibility.

add-custom-tag-to-paragraph.title: Add Custom Tag to Paragraph in Tagged PDF
add-custom-tag-to-paragraph.description: Demonstrates opening a PDF, accessing its tagged content, creating a paragraph element, assigning a custom tag name, and saving the updated tagged PDF.

add-external-link-with-title-to-tagged-p.title: Add External Link with Title to Tagged PDF
add-external-link-with-title-to-tagged-p.description: Shows how to insert a clickable link annotation that points to an external URL and set its title/tooltip in a tagged PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-internal-page-link-to-tagged-pdf.title: Create Internal /Link Element in a Tagged PDF
add-internal-page-link-to-tagged-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to add an internal page link to a PDF while using the tagged‑content API to set the element role to "/Link" for accessibility.

add-note-element-to-paragraph.title: Add Note Element to Paragraph in Tagged PDF
add-note-element-to-paragraph.description: Shows how to create a note element as a child of a paragraph in a tagged PDF, set document language and title, and save the updated file using Aspose.Pdf.

add-caption-note-to-figure.title: Add Caption to Figure Using Note Element in Tagged PDF
add-caption-note-to-figure.description: Demonstrates how to create a figure element in a tagged PDF and attach a note element as a caption using Aspose.Pdf.

add-actualtext-to-images.title: Add ActualText Attribute to Image Figure in Tagged PDF
add-actualtext-to-images.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, using the TaggedContent API to create a Figure element for an image, setting AlternativeText and ActualText attributes, and saving the updated document.

set-actualtext-span-pronunciation.title: Set Hidden Pronunciation Text with ActualText on a Span
set-actualtext-span-pronunciation.description: Shows how to create a span element in a tagged PDF, assign visible text and hidden pronunciation text via the ActualText property, and save the document using Aspose.Pdf.

update-tagged-element-language-french.title: Update Language of a Tagged PDF Paragraph to French
update-tagged-element-language-french.description: Demonstrates how to access the logical structure tree of a tagged PDF with Aspose.Pdf, locate the first paragraph element, set its Language property to French (fr-FR), and save the modified document.

set-primary-language-for-tagged-pdf.title: Set Primary Language for Tagged PDF
set-primary-language-for-tagged-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to add a language attribute to the structure tree of a tagged PDF using Aspose.Pdf, enabling proper language identification for accessibility tools.

propagate-language-attribute-to-tagged-p.title: Propagate Language Attribute to All Tagged PDF Elements
propagate-language-attribute-to-tagged-p.description: Demonstrates how to set a language attribute on the root of a tagged PDF and automatically propagate it to every descendant structure element using Aspose.Pdf.

create-tagged-3x4-table-in-pdf.title: Add Tagged Table to PDF for Accessibility
create-tagged-3x4-table-in-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to create a three‑row, four‑column table in a PDF's logical structure tree using Aspose.Pdf's tagged content API, enabling accessibility features.

create-tagged-pdf-table-with-merged-head.title: Create Tagged Table with Header Cells in PDF
create-tagged-pdf-table-with-merged-head.description: Demonstrates how to add a tagged table to an existing PDF, merge cells for a header row, assign the TH role, set the /ActualText attribute for each header, and save the accessible PDF.

style-table-cells-background-border-padd.title: Style Table Cells with Background, Border, and Padding
style-table-cells-background-border-padd.description: Creates a PDF containing a 3×3 table where each cell is given a light‑gray background, a 1‑point border, and uniform padding for better visual accessibility.

custom-table-cell-borders-by-row-index.title: Apply Custom Borders to Table Cells by Row Index
custom-table-cell-borders-by-row-index.description: Demonstrates how to create a PDF table with Aspose.Pdf and apply different border colors and thicknesses to cells based on whether the row index is even or odd.

create-tagged-table-with-custom-tags.title: Tag Table Cells with Data Types and Validate PDF/UA Compliance
create-tagged-table-with-custom-tags.description: Demonstrates how to create a tagged PDF table, assign custom data‑type tags to each cell using AlternativeText, and validate the document for PDF/UA 1.0 compliance with Aspose.Pdf.

nested-table-in-paragraph-tagged-pdf.title: Create Nested Table Inside Paragraph in Tagged PDF
nested-table-in-paragraph-tagged-pdf.description: Demonstrates adding a paragraph to a tagged PDF, embedding an outer table that contains a nested table within its first cell, and walking the structure tree to validate the tagging hierarchy.

create-nested-bullet-numbered-lists-tagg.title: Create Tagged PDF with Bullet and Numbered Lists
create-nested-bullet-numbered-lists-tagg.description: Demonstrates how to generate a PDF with tagged content and add simple bullet and numbered list items using Aspose.Pdf.

add-textbox-form-field-tagged-pdf.title: Create a Form Field and Associate It with a Tagged /Form Element
add-textbox-form-field-tagged-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to add a TextBox field to the AcroForm of a PDF, create a /Form structure element in the tagged content tree, and link the field to that element for accessibility.

add-placeholder-textbox-form-field-tagge.title: Add Text Box Form Field with Placeholder to PDF
add-placeholder-textbox-form-field-tagge.description: Demonstrates how to insert a TextBox form field with placeholder text into a PDF and associate it with the document's AcroForm (/Form) element using Aspose.Pdf.

add-page-break-to-tagged-pdf.title: Add Page Break Element to Tagged PDF
add-page-break-to-tagged-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to insert a PageBreak element into the logical structure tree of a PDF to improve accessibility, then adds a paragraph after the break and saves the document.

update-paragraph-actualtext-in-tagged-pd.title: Update Paragraph ActualText in a Tagged PDF
update-paragraph-actualtext-in-tagged-pd.description: Demonstrates loading a tagged PDF, locating a paragraph by its ActualText (used as a title), and updating the ActualText value to correct the content.

replace-note-element-in-tagged-pdf.title: Replace Existing PDF Note Annotation with Updated Text
replace-note-element-in-tagged-pdf.description: Shows how to locate a text annotation (note) by its title, remove the old annotation, and add a new note with updated title and content using Aspose.Pdf.

iterate-tagged-pdf-structure-elements.title: Log Tagged PDF Structure Elements
iterate-tagged-pdf-structure-elements.description: Loads a PDF, checks if it is tagged, traverses the structure tree, and logs each element's tag name, language, and title (actual text). Demonstrates basic accessibility extraction with Aspose.Pdf.

set-paragraph-title-in-tagged-pdf.title: Set Paragraph Title for PDF Accessibility
set-paragraph-title-in-tagged-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to enable tagged PDF features, set document language and title, create a paragraph element, assign a Title attribute to the paragraph for accessibility, and save the PDF.

set-figure-title-in-tagged-pdf.title: Set Figure Title (Alternative Text) in a Tagged PDF
set-figure-title-in-tagged-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to programmatically add a FigureElement to a tagged PDF and set its concise description using the AlternativeText property with Aspose.Pdf.

check-pdf-ua-compliance-and-log.title: Check PDF/UA Compliance and Log Result
check-pdf-ua-compliance-and-log.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, validating it against PDF/UA‑1 standards, and outputting the boolean compliance result for further processing.

summarize-pdf-validation-errors.title: Parse XML Validation Report for Error Summary
summarize-pdf-validation-errors.description: Shows how to load an XML validation report, extract error/violation elements, aggregate occurrences by error code, and output a summary with sample messages and top violations.

filter-xml-missing-alt-text.title: Find Images Missing Alt Text in Validation XML
filter-xml-missing-alt-text.description: Loads an XML validation report, selects Image elements that have an Id attribute but no non‑empty Alt attribute, and outputs the list of affected image IDs.

extract-text-from-tagged-pdf-structure.title: Extract Text from a Tagged PDF via Structure Tree Traversal
extract-text-from-tagged-pdf-structure.description: The example loads a PDF, checks if it is tagged, and if so walks the logical structure tree to output visible and alternative text for each element. If the document is not tagged it falls back to raw text extraction with TextAbsorber.

export-structure-tree-to-xml-xsl-report.title: Export PDF Structure Tree to XML and Generate HTML Report via XSLT
export-structure-tree-to-xml-xsl-report.description: Demonstrates how to export a PDF's logical structure tree to an XML file using Aspose.Pdf and then transform it with XSLT to produce an HTML report.

export-pdf-structure-tree-to-json.title: Export PDF Structure Tree to JSON
export-pdf-structure-tree-to-json.description: Loads a tagged PDF, traverses its logical structure tree, and serializes the hierarchy (element type, text, alt text, language) to a JSON file for accessibility analysis.

export-tagged-pdf-content-to-json.title: Export Tagged PDF Structure to JSON
export-tagged-pdf-content-to-json.description: Loads a PDF, verifies that it contains a tagged structure, traverses the logical structure tree, and writes the hierarchy (type, text, alt text, language) to a formatted JSON file.

extract-notes-from-tagged-pdf.title: Extract PDF Note Annotations to Text File
extract-notes-from-tagged-pdf.description: The example opens a PDF, iterates through all pages and their annotations, extracts the contents of TextAnnotation (sticky‑note) objects, concatenates them, and saves the result to a plain text file.

extract-pdf-links-to-csv.title: Extract PDF Links to CSV
extract-pdf-links-to-csv.description: Shows how to open a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through its pages to collect link annotations, retrieve the target URLs, and write them to a CSV file.

batch-tag-pdfs-with-suffix.title: Batch Tag PDFs for Accessibility
batch-tag-pdfs-with-suffix.description: Iterates through all PDF files in a folder, adds basic accessibility tags (language, title, a paragraph) using Aspose.Pdf's tagging API, and saves each file with a custom suffix.

batch-convert-pdfs-to-tagged-pdfa.title: Batch Auto‑Tag PDFs and Save Tagged Versions
batch-convert-pdfs-to-tagged-pdfa.description: Demonstrates how to process a folder of untagged PDFs, enable Aspose.Pdf auto‑tagging, optionally set accessibility metadata, and save each document as a tagged PDF in a separate output folder.

batch-validate-pdfs-summary-csv.title: Batch Validate PDFs and Generate XML Logs with Summary CSV
batch-validate-pdfs-summary-csv.description: The example iterates through a folder of PDF files, uses Aspose.Pdf to check basic structural validity, creates an XML log for each file, and writes a summary CSV with the validation results.

batch-pdfa1b-validation-xml-logs-dashboa.title: Batch Validate PDFs for PDF/UA Compliance and Show Dashboard
batch-pdfa1b-validation-xml-logs-dashboa.description: The example processes all PDF files in a folder, validates each one for PDF/UA compliance using Aspose.Pdf, writes XML logs, and displays a console dashboard with per‑file and average compliance percentages.

set-missing-language-attributes.title: Set Default Language for PDF Structure Elements
set-missing-language-attributes.description: Demonstrates how to ensure every logical structure element in a tagged PDF has an explicit language attribute by assigning a default language where missing.
